name: Hebrews
section: New Testament: General Letters and Revelation
author: Not named in the text. The author is unknown, and several names have been suggested.
date: Usually dated before AD 70, though not certain.
setting: Written to believers tempted to turn back.
genre: Sermon in the form of a letter.
theme: Jesus is greater than angels, Moses, and the priests, and his sacrifice is final.

outline.label: God has spoken by his Son

christInBook: Hebrews presents Jesus as superior to the prophets, angels, Moses, and the Levitical priesthood. He is the great high priest and the once-for-all sacrifice who sat down at the right hand of God.
howToRead: Hebrews alternates between exposition and warning. Notice the repeated word “better” and the five warning passages. The letter is written as a word of exhortation to endure.
